name: pnp-powershell
description: Manage Microsoft 365 in natural language with PnP PowerShell and author PnP PowerShell scripts.
long_description:
Runs PnP PowerShell against SharePoint Online, Teams and Entra ID from a conversation, with a confirmation prompt before destructive commands and an optional read-only mode.

Requires PowerShell 7.4 or above and the PnP.PowerShell module on this machine. Ask it to check the PnP PowerShell setup and it reports what is missing.

tools.name: pnp_diagnose_connection
tools.description: Checks that pwsh and PnP.PowerShell are installed and reports how this machine can sign in.

tools.name: pnp_setup_environment
tools.description: Installs the PnP.PowerShell module, only when setup is allowed.

tools.name: pnp_get_connection_status
tools.description: Reports which site and account a session is connected as.

tools.name: pnp_run_command
tools.description: Runs PnP PowerShell against the connected tenant.

tools.name: pnp_get_result_page
tools.description: Returns the next page of a result too large to return whole.

tools.name: pnp_search_commands
tools.description: Finds the cmdlet for a task described in plain words.

tools.name: pnp_get_command_docs
tools.description: Gets the syntax, parameters and examples of one cmdlet.

tools.name: pnp_suggest_script
tools.description: Suggests community script samples for a task.

tools.name: pnp_search_script_samples
tools.description: Searches community and your own script samples.

tools.name: pnp_save_script_sample
tools.description: Saves a script to your own sample folder.

tools.name: pnp_get_best_practices
tools.description: Returns this server's guidance, whole or by section.

tools.name: pnp_list_sessions
tools.description: Lists the PowerShell sessions the server holds.

tools.name: pnp_reset_session
tools.description: Ends a session and its connection.

tools.name: pnp_ping
tools.description: Reports server version, uptime and readiness.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Refuse every command that would change Microsoft 365.

allow_setup.title: Allow module install
allow_setup.description: Let the server install the PnP.PowerShell module for the current user when it is missing.
